welcome.title: Your AI workspace is ready
welcome.subtitle: Bokito brings your customer conversations, an AI workforce and human control together in one operating system. Here is how it fits together.

communication.title: Communication
communication.body: Email, website chat and internal threads land in one inbox. AI triages, drafts and asks you when it matters.

ai.title: AI workforce
ai.body: Agents with clear permissions do the work. Projects and Knowledge give them context that grows over time.

automations.title: Automations
automations.body: Schedules and triggers run work in the background, visible on your agenda.

cockpit.title: Cockpit
cockpit.body: KPIs, costs and activity in one view, so you always know what your workspace is doing.

control.title: You stay in control
control.body: Decisions come to you inline. Dial autonomy up or down whenever you want.

communication.title: Communication
communication.body: Every channel lands here: email, website chat and threads with your agents. AI handles the routine and asks for your decision when it matters.

ai.title: Your AI workforce
ai.body: Agents are your digital coworkers. Projects group their work, and Knowledge is what they learn from. Teach it once, they use it everywhere.

agenda.title: Agenda
agenda.body: Scheduled runs and background automations. Set them up once and work happens while you are away.

cockpit.title: Cockpit
cockpit.body: Your control tower: KPIs, autonomy, costs and everything your workspace has done.

settings.title: Settings and setup guide
settings.body: Channels, branding, your team and the step-by-step setup guide all live here.

finish.title: Set up together with your assistant
finish.body: The fastest way to configure Bokito is a conversation. Your assistant interviews you about your company and sets up channels, agents, knowledge and KPIs with you.
finish.later: I will explore on my own

setupPrompt: I just created my Bokito workspace. Interview me about my company and help me set everything up step by step: communication channels, agents, knowledge, automations and the KPIs that matter to me. Ask one question at a time.
